metadata.question: On August 2, 2018, did the water temperature at Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) show a higher temperature anomaly, when compared to the long-term average for this time of year, than that observed at Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need Sea Surface Temperature (SST) data - Best dataset: NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1 (daily SST with long-term climatology) - Date: August 2, 2018 - Need long-term average for early August (climatology) - Locations: Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) and Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924) 2. Masking strategy: - Check for valid SST data (not land pixels) - No cloud masking needed for SST product 3. Logic: - Calculate SST anomaly = SST on Aug 2, 2018 - Long-term average for early August - Compare anomalies: Long Beach anomaly > Pismo Beach anomaly → A, else → B - Check for missing data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const longBeach = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.089042, 33.601421]); const pismoBeach = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.727924, 35.128348]); const targetDate = '2018-08-02'; // 2. Data Acquisition // NOAA OISST V2.1 dataset with SST and climatology const oisst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1'); // Get SST for target date const targetImg = oisst .filterDate('2018-08-02', '2018-08-03') .first(); // Check if image exists const imgCount = oisst.filterDate('2018-08-02', '2018-08-03').size().getInfo(); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log("No SST data for August 2, 2018."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get long-term climatology for early August (day of year ~214) // Use a 7-day window around Aug 2 for climatology const climatology = oisst .filterDate('1981-07-30', '2017-08-05') .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(213, 217)) .select('sst') .mean(); // 3. Calculate anomalies const sst = targetImg.select('sst'); const anomaly = sst.subtract(climatology); // 4. Extract values at both locations const longBeachSST = sst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: longBeach, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst'); const longBeachAnomaly = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: longBeach, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst'); const pismoBeachSST = sst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: pismoBeach, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst'); const pismoBeachAnomaly = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: pismoBeach, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst'); const lbSST = await longBeachSST.getInfo(); const lbAnom = await longBeachAnomaly.getInfo(); const pbSST = await pismoBeachSST.getInfo(); const pbAnom = await pismoBeachAnomaly.getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Results console.log(`Long Beach - SST: ${lbSST !== null ? lbSST.toFixed(2) : 'null'} C, Anomaly: ${lbAnom !== null ? lbAnom.toFixed(2) : 'null'} C`); console.log(`Pismo Beach - SST: ${pbSST !== null ? pbSST.toFixed(2) : 'null'} C, Anomaly: ${pbAnom !== null ? pbAnom.toFixed(2) : 'null'} C`); if (lbAnom === null || pbAnom === null || lbSST === null || pbSST === null) { console.log("Missing or invalid SST data at one or both locations."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (isNaN(lbAnom) || isNaN(pbAnom)) { console.log("Calculation produced NaN values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Final Answer if (lbAnom > pbAnom) { console.log("Long Beach shows higher temperature anomaly."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Long Beach does not show higher temperature anomaly."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
